definition: A data file that is neither a model, documentation, metadata nor code.
Human-readable documentation of the package or of the object it describes.
A file describing the package or its contents, such as MD.cff or CITATION.cff.
A file holding the three-dimensional geometry or texture of the documented object.
An executable script that is part of the package rather than of a released software component.
A source, build or configuration file of a software component.
